n40e1f8a34e.headline: UNCTAD: FDI in strong growth in Morocco
n40e1f8a34e.summary: Morocco attracted $2.7 billion in FDI in 2017, marking a 23% increase compared to the previous year, with strong diversification of investments.
n40e1f8a34e.why: FDI inflows are key indicators of economic health and investor confidence, impacting Morocco's growth prospects and regional economic integration.
